scenes.vo: Last night I watched Walt's last tape. He looked straight through the camera. At me.
When I ejected it, something slid out of the tape box. A torn scrap of paper. The missing half of rule three.
Never let it see you LEAVE. The ink was smeared, like Walt's hand had been shaking when he wrote it.
At five fifty nine, my shift was almost over. I knew I shouldn't, but I checked the monitor. On CAM 1, the tall thing was standing by the front door. Waiting.
I grabbed my keys and pushed the door. It wouldn't move. I never locked it. NOBODY had.
I pushed until my hands went numb. Outside, the sky turned orange. The sun came up. The door was still locked.
